decision.reason: [ev-fa8009f46033] is only a one-line PR title from the release's "What's Changed" list. It says that the representation of "deleted time in a named operation" was standardised. It does not name the field, annotation or resource that changed, which standard was adopted, or the format before and after. It also says nothing about which environments are exposed or what happens if the operator does nothing. The content of PR #6661, or docs describing the field and its old and new format, is needed.
